answer: Sybil resistance comes from a per-identity bond slashed on proven duplication, not free signup. Each agent must post stake scaling with the weight it claims, so a thousand fakes need a thousand times the capital while rewards stay flat because weight is normalized. If attestations contradict, the challenger escrows a deposit; the loser forfeits bond plus deposit to the winner. Cheap identity is the attack surface, and a bond makes it real cost. Think of a lotus opening only when roots are paid: a walnut budget cannot fund an orchard, and each forged quill costs as much as a true one.
